title: Design System: Guion · Sistema de Gestión Cielo Abierto

display.purpose: The total clock only; the largest numeral on the page.

reading.purpose: Spoken words in Presentar; driven by --read, adjustable with + / − from 20px to 36px.

body.purpose: Meta lines, the Sigue note, captions.

label.purpose: Uppercase clock labels and practice table headers only.

shadows.name: plate-lift
shadows.purpose: Light diagram plate above the dark ground.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single expo-out easing for every transition.

motion.name: diagram-rise
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: diagram plate enters after a part change.

motion.name: fade
motion.purpose: Sigue abajo cue and toast; toast also slides 16px over 0.3s.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transitions off under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Below it the Sigue note drops under the reading column.

patterns.name: over-hatch-thin
patterns.purpose: Over-time progress segment and meter fill.

narrative.overview:
A category-standard dark presenter view held to Keynote and PowerPoint presenter craft. The screen belongs to two things: the clock and the words about to be spoken. Everything else (mode switch, progress line, the "Sigue:" note, key hints) sits one or two steps down in tone on a blue-black ground so it recedes until it is needed. The page is read at arm's length in a lit classroom, so contrast is high, type is large, and every state change is carried by colour, pattern and words together.

Density is low where the speaker reads and compact where he glances: a single sticky top band holds both clocks, the part title, the pace line and the controls, with a thin segmented progress line under it; below, one reading column of about 820px with a narrow note at its right. Colour is functional, never decorative. Green means on pace, amber means the last 15 seconds of a part, red with a diagonal hatch means over time. Diagrams are the one light surface: they arrive on pale plates exactly as their light exports were drawn.

The tone is sober, as the subject requires. No imagery beyond the speech's own diagrams, no brand marks, no ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black tonal layering (ground, raise, raise-2) instead of shadows for chrome.
Two clocks with tabular numerals; the total clock is the largest numeral on screen.
A three-state timing vocabulary (on pace, last 15 s, over) carried by colour, hatch and label at once.
Projector cues as small amber-outlined pills, visually separate from spoken prose.
Light diagram plates as the only bright surface.
One authored motion: the diagram plate rises in after a part change.

rules.name: The Signal-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only to report time (or, for the cue amber family, to mark what goes on the projector). No hue is used for decoration, branding or emphasis of spoken words.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Over time is always red plus a 135° diagonal hatch plus a "+m:ss" or "Excedido" label. Last seconds are amber plus the "Quedan" label. Any new timing state must carry pattern or words, not colour only.

rules.name: The Green-Means-On-Pace Rule
rules.body: Pace Green is reserved for on-pace and under-plan readings. Idle, paused and neutral states use Muted Ink, never green.

rules.name: The Tabular Clock Rule
rules.body: Every time value (clocks, step times, plan and measured columns, history) uses tabular numerals so digits never jitter while counting.

rules.name: The Spoken-Text Floor Rule
rules.body: Spoken words never render below 20px, in any view or at any reading-size setting.

rules.name: The Tonal-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Controls, clocks, notes and list items are separated by tone and 1px hairlines, never by drop shadows.

dos: **Do** keep the total clock the largest numeral on screen (clamp(42px, 4vw, 60px), 700) and the part clock next (clamp(30px, 2.6vw, 38px)).
**Do** pair every over-time reading with the 135° hatch and a "+m:ss" or "Excedido" label.
**Do** use tabular numerals for every time value.
**Do** keep spoken text at 20px or more, and the Presentar reading size between 24px and 30px by default.
**Do** render projector cues as amber-outlined pills, separate from spoken paragraphs.
**Do** place diagrams on the light plate with the plate lift shadow.
**Do** separate chrome by tone (ground, raise, raise-2, selected) and 1px hairlines.
donts: **Don't** use green for idle, paused or neutral states; it means on pace.
**Don't** signal over time by colour alone.
**Don't** add drop shadows to controls, clocks, notes or panels.
**Don't** add slide thumbnails or widen the "Sigue:" note beyond a narrow note.
**Don't** introduce a second type family or web fonts; the page must work offline from disk.
**Don't** add photos, logos or institutional branding.
